title: This Free GitHub Repo Fixes Claude Code Token Limits
description:
The #1 community for building a highly-profitable personal brand with AI and Claude Code.
👉 https://www.skool.com/buildroom/

Summary ⤵️

Most people burn through Claude Code limits way too fast—and don’t realize why.

The issue is context loading.

Every new session forces Claude to re-read massive parts of your codebase:
→ Files
→ Functions
→ Relationships
→ Dependencies

That means thousands of tokens disappear before real work even starts.

Now a tool called Graphify changes that.

Instead of re-reading files every session, it builds a knowledge graph of your codebase so Claude can navigate relationships directly.

Result:
→ Far lower token usage
→ Faster sessions
→ Better continuity on large projects

Reality check:
This won’t fix poorly structured codebases.
Bad architecture still creates bad outputs.

But for larger repos, this is a huge optimization.

Check my pinned comment below for the link

#aitools #claudecode #github #automation #coding
